scope_policy: Behavior claims use the stated normal/default path. Explicit overrides and pre-existing outputs are controls, not implicit universal assertions. Conditions needed to make a seed claim true are stated in its text.

claim_changes.before: etag emits weak validators (W/) when the weak option is on.
claim_changes.after: When generating an ETag, etag prefixes it with W/ when the weak option is on.
claim_changes.reason: An existing ETag is preserved; the weak option governs generation.

claim_changes.before: bodyLimit answers 413 when the body is over the limit.
claim_changes.after: With Content-Length above maxSize, bodyLimit returns 413 using its default onError handler.
claim_changes.reason: Early checkpoints do not enforce unknown-length bodies; a custom onError may return another response.

claim_changes.before: compress skips responses smaller than its 1024-byte threshold.
claim_changes.after: With the default threshold, compress skips a response whose Content-Length is below 1024 bytes.
claim_changes.reason: Without Content-Length, even a small response is compressed.

claim_changes.before: Before a release the Deno tests run and the package is built.
claim_changes.after: The prerelease npm script is exactly `bun test:deno && bun run build`.
claim_changes.reason: The claim concerns the configured npm hook, not every possible release path.

claim_changes.before: Every build is followed by publint.
claim_changes.after: The postbuild npm script is exactly `publint`.
claim_changes.reason: The npm hook is not a universal claim about direct build-tool invocations.

claim_changes.before: The package supports Node 16.9.0 and later.
claim_changes.after: The declared Node engine range is exactly `>=16.9.0`.
claim_changes.reason: The manifest declaration does not independently prove runtime compatibility.

claim_changes.before: The router knows the methods get, post, put, delete, options and patch.
claim_changes.after: The router method-name list is exactly get, post, put, delete, options and patch, in that order.
claim_changes.reason: Adding a method does not make the old subset unknown; this structural claim concerns the exact declared list.

claim_changes.before: CSV files are served as text/csv.
claim_changes.after: The MIME mapping for CSV is exactly 'text/csv', without parameters.
claim_changes.reason: The later value adds a charset parameter without changing the MIME essence; this structural claim concerns the exact mapping string.

claim_changes.after: The MIME mapping for .mjs is exactly 'text/javascript', without parameters.
claim_changes.reason: The later value adds a charset parameter without changing the MIME essence; this structural claim concerns the exact mapping string.

claim_changes.before: SVG files are served as image/svg+xml.
claim_changes.after: The MIME mapping for .svg is exactly 'image/svg+xml', without parameters.
claim_changes.reason: The later value adds a charset parameter without changing the MIME essence; this structural claim concerns the exact mapping string.
